Interface IResearcher

All Known Implementing Classes:
Dean, Employee, Manager, Rector, Student, Teacher
public interface IResearcher
Marks an entity as capable of having a research profile.

Implemented by Student, Employee (and all its subclasses). A null ResearchProfile means the entity is not an active researcher; setting a non-null profile activates research capabilities. Default methods provide safe delegating accessors that return neutral values when the profile is absent, so callers never need null-checks.

Design note: chosen as an interface (rather than an abstract class or Decorator) to allow orthogonal mix-in across the existing inheritance hierarchy — both Student and Employee subtypes can be researchers without forced single-inheritance constraints.
